8 ارتمى It was, or became, thrown, cast, or flung. (S, K, TA.) It fell to the ground: so in the saying, ارتمى الحِمْلُ عَنْ ظَهْرِ البَعِيرِ [The load fell to the ground, or it may mean was thrown down, from the back of the camel]. (T.) ―
-b2- Also He shot, or shot at, an animal, or animals, of the chase. (T, S, M.) ―
-b3- See also 6, in three places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
